hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if m=$(grep -nE '^(<{7}( |$)|={7}$|>{7}( |$)|\|{7}( |$))' "$f"); then printf 'Merge-conflict markers left in %s:\n%s\n' "$f" "$m" >&2; exit 2; fi

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; f=$(realpath -m "$f"); case "$f" in "$HOME"/.terminal/skills/*) out=$(sync-skills 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
